BN254 point compression, decompression, addition, scalar mul, and pairing syscall helpers.

# Purpose
This file implements BN254 elliptic curve point encoding and curve operation entry points. It provides [`fd_bn254_g1_compress`](<#fd_bn254_g1_compress>), [`fd_bn254_g1_decompress`](<#fd_bn254_g1_decompress>), [`fd_bn254_g2_compress`](<#fd_bn254_g2_compress>), and [`fd_bn254_g2_decompress`](<#fd_bn254_g2_decompress>) to convert between affine point byte formats and compressed forms for the `G1` and `G2` groups. The code handles the point-at-infinity flag, sign flag, field square root recovery, and byte order conversion. It also includes the curve and field source files needed to build the implementation in one translation unit.

The file also defines syscall-style helpers for curve operations: [`fd_bn254_g1_add_syscall`](<#fd_bn254_g1_add_syscall>), [`fd_bn254_g1_scalar_mul_syscall`](<#fd_bn254_g1_scalar_mul_syscall>), and [`fd_bn254_pairing_is_one_syscall`](<#fd_bn254_pairing_is_one_syscall>). These functions parse input buffers, validate `G1` and `G2` points with subgroup checks, perform point addition, scalar multiplication, and pairing aggregation, then serialize the result for external use. The pairing function processes batches of `(G1, G2)` pairs, skips pairs that contain the point at infinity, runs the Miller loop, applies the final exponentiation, and returns whether the pairing result is equal to one.
